page.text:
A *binary operation* on $X$ is a function taking an ordered pair of
elements from $X$ and returning a value in $X$: $* : X \times X \to X$.
We write $x * y$ using infix notation. Binary operations are the
foundational building blocks of abstract algebra, equipping sets with
arithmetic structures such as groups, rings, and vector spaces.
